question: Suppose that in a sports tournament featuring $n$ players, each pair plays one game and there is always a winner and a loser (no draws). Show that the players can be arranged in an order $P_1,P_2,\ldots,P_n$ such that player $P_i$ has beaten $P_{i+1}$ for all $i=1,2,\ldots,n-1$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
